useCases.title: Green Lane Verified: Wallet-Based Company Formation and Registration
useCases.summary:
Green Lane is a voluntary digital route for registering a sole proprietorship with KVK or incorporating a legal entity, such as a BV, through a civil-law notary.
Entrepreneurs retrieve verified identity and evidence data from authoritative sources into an eIDAS-compliant personal wallet and share only the data needed for a specific purpose. This reduces repeated document requests, manual checks and corrections, while giving entrepreneurs more control over their data.
KVK and notaries remain responsible for all legal, professional and risk-based assessments and may request additional information. Green Lane does not guarantee approval, registration or trustworthiness. Its status only confirms that an agreed data set was verifiably supplied and met defined quality criteria. Verified business data may later be reused through a business wallet for KYC, onboarding and other business relationships.

Submitted on behalf of the Green Lane collaboration. Pre-pilot fase.
useCases.userJourney:
The entrepreneur voluntarily chooses the Green Lane when registering a sole proprietorship with KVK or incorporating a legal entity through a civil-law notary.
Verified personal data is retrieved into a digital wallet, while any missing business information is added by the entrepreneur. The wallet shows what data is requested, why it is needed, who receives it and whether it is verified or self-declared.
After consent, KVK or the notary receives and validates the data, while remaining responsible for the legal and risk-based assessment. Missing or conflicting information may require additional review.
Once approved, the business is registered and a digital Green Lane statement may be issued. The data and status must be kept up to date.
